Sam H: Heads up — I'm booking the midwave deploy slot for tomorrow 10:30 PT. Short list: auth-service patch, kv-cache hotfix, and tokenizer v2 rollout. Quick check: who can own canary + smoke and have rollback ready?

Jess L: I can take canary. I'll be online 10:15-11:00 PT and run the canary users through the harness.

Owen K: I'll own smoke and rollback. I'll prepare the rollback playbook and stand by on pager.

Maria R: Is there a DB migration for auth-service? need to know lock window.

Jess L: It's an additive column with default — zero-downtime. Migration lives at https://git.redwood/auth/migrations/PR-423. I'll include `--batch` in the script.

Sam H: Nice. Owen — can you confirm the exact smoke command we should run? Also we need a quick tokenization QA (v2) check.

Owen K: Smoke command: `./ci/smoke.sh --env staging --routes auth,tokenizer`
I'll paste the snippet: ```#!/bin/bash
./ci/smoke.sh --env staging --routes auth,tokenizer
# expect 200s and latency < 120ms
```

deploy-bot: Reserved slot confirmed: 2026-04-10 10:30 PT -> 11:00 PT. Projected tokens: ~3.2M. To opt into canary, react with :white_check_mark:.

Sam H: Jess, please add the canary config to the release job and pin the image tag. Start rollout at 5% until green.

Jess L: On it — I'll push branch `release/canary-423` and open a PR with the canary job.

Maria R: Reviewed the migration SQL — looks safe. I'll standby to monitor DB metrics during rollout.

Owen K: Rollback steps (short): 1) revert deployment 2) restore redis snapshot if errors persist 3) shift router weights back to stable. I'll include a one-page playbook in the runbook.

Sam H: If no objections by EOD I'll finalize the schedule and add owners to the release calendar. Anyone else to add?

Maria R: No objections from infra side.

Jess L: None from me.

Sam H: Great, thanks everyone. I'll post the final handoff + runbook link once done.
